credit_rule: Each additional question costs 1 credit. Each answer earns 1 credit.
no_credits: Your free question is used. Answer someone to earn a credit.
privacy: Anonymous means pseudonymous: your node code is used to deliver private answers. Do not include identifying details in question text.
credits_local: Credits and the daily free-question counter are stored on this device. Without accounts or a global consensus ledger they are not Sybil-proof.
